Why do we have this file?
Done

Why do we need a return value from this API?
Any error will be logged internally. Also there is no action other than logging dependent on return value. 
So that makes return type moot in this case?
The bash script returns value 0 in case of success and 1 in case of failure. I kept return value here to preserve the same behavior.
Acknowledged

We have already merged the base framework for logger class. Could you please make use of the class API now for logging.
Applies for other instances as well.
Done
This is configurable, so the comment may not hold good in some situation. Let the comment be generic?
Acknowledged
Just add a todo to revisit this code as we will be moving to xyz interface for collection status value.
Done
A blank line between different blocks?
Done
No action based on return type so I don't see a need to handling return value.
The bash script returns value 0 in case of success and 1 in case of failure. I kept return value here to preserve the same behavior.
Acknowledged
Nothing is being thrown from the API. This is a dead code?
Done
variable name CLI_dep should be enough I guess. in case if we upgrade CLI version, we need to change the variable name as well.
Done

should we have -1 in case of error/exception ?
or value 1 is enough to identify not completed status or error scenario ?
The bash script returns 1 incase of any error. Just preserving the same behavior here. We can revisit after we implement error codes in our repository.

The value is to be ultimately returned back from main. No internal processing depends on that.
Any non zero return type is considered as failed. So I am ok be -1 or +1.
okay

should we first check and then go for sleep ?
it will be use full, if this app run by manually/explicitly.

This app is mimicking the bash script's flow. 

>it will be use full, if this app run by manually/explicitly.

In what use case will it be run manually?

This app will be extended further to trigger collection of all FRUs before calling this API which will take way more than 2 seconds. Hence sleep before of after does not impact in this particular case.

|In what use case will it be run manually?
application is using CLI command line parser, and user can pass the arguments. any one/application can use/run this app to check on the collection status.

| This app will be extended further to trigger collection of all FRUs before calling this API which will take way more than 2 seconds.
okay
VPD CollectionStatus.
Done

should we return, why we need retry in this case ?
as we again read the value from DBus, we may get the same type, which is not expected.
This is a rare scenario where "CollectionStatus" value is not of type `std::string`. I think we should still re-try. I have removed the "invalid type" log to prevent journal flooding in case it hits.
I agree, as this is a critical step where collection status of the system is to be set. We should try to the maximum before we set failed status.
Acknowledged
sleepDurationInSeconds
